skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 3 consecutive strikes for 135% ATK.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases Crit DMG by 30% for 1 turn.Deals 105% of max HP as Direct DMG to a column target with 3 consecutive strikes, plus additional Specialized Extra DMG equal to 120% of original max HP (extra Crit DMG applies).[Aura] increases Specialized Extra DMG by 20%.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Crit DMG 30% → 50%Max HP DMG 105% → 135%Specialized Extra DMG 120% → 140%[Aura] increase 20% → 25%

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains 60% Non-Crit DMG Free (damage reduction includes all damage types; cannot coexist with Agility).Increases 1500 Energy before taking action.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the beginning of the round, 200% of Metal Bat's Max HP and 80% of Max HP of allies in the same row is recovered, lasts up to 4 rounds. Before any character takes action, the life armor he possess will be permanently increased by [Aura] (1 layer of armor equals to 1 layer of aura, up to 4 layers, calculated based on the highest number of layers of own armor). Own Crit hit rate is permanently increased by 50% and the Crit hit rate of allies is permanently increased by 30%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Max HP Recovered 200% > 250% Max HP Recovered (allies) 80% > 120% Aura max layers 4 > 6 Crit hit rate 50% > 70% Crit hit rate (allies) 30% > 50%
